goal: Test baseline disclosure with real user input
steps: Capture initial heading structure and collapsed/expanded states
Focus Who can apply? and press Enter
Record aria-expanded and target visibility
Press Space and verify return to collapsed
Inspect expanded content without JavaScript

goal: Test experimental themed accordion
steps: Capture initial disclosure semantics and focus indicator
Use keyboard Enter and Space
Repeat with theme=dark and with dir=rtl
Compare icon and text against adjacent surfaces
Check forced colors using browser emulation

goal: Confirm message meaning without color cues
steps: Capture alert names, headings and content
Identify how information, warnings and errors differ semantically
Review zoom behavior and visible text

goal: Review dark-mode warning/error/info layers
steps: Compare baseline and experimental colors
Open theme=dark
Inspect contrast and non-color distinctions
Check forced-colors handling
Document unresolved contrast measurements

goal: Test default banner disclosure and identity copy
steps: Capture banner region and accessible name
Open disclosure with keyboard
Confirm neutral demo copy avoids government endorsement
Examine narrow screen layout

goal: Test themed banner and logical layout
steps: Repeat baseline disclosure steps
Open dir=rtl and inspect logical spacing
Open theme=dark and inspect boundaries
Confirm browser keyboard interaction after theme change

goal: Reproduce required radio and text validation
steps: Capture form structure and name/role for radio options
Submit without responses and note native validation/focus
Choose New application and provide a name
Submit and verify no information is sent to any service

goal: Compare focused controls and native validation in the experimental theme
steps: Repeat baseline validation with keyboard
Inspect focus and validation with theme=dark
Inspect control boundaries in forced colors
Record if real Voice Control testing remains outstanding

goal: Exercise the Radio validation baseline fixture with real browser input
steps: Capture the initial accessibility snapshot and page title
Confirm the variant label matches the page you opened
Identify the component and its accessible name, role, and state
Submit the empty form and record native validation and focus placement
Complete the required controls with the keyboard and submit the local success path
Record any difference from the baseline without calling it a regression before reproduction
